name: Fujishima Ritsuko
source:
Rena's daughter and member of the school's public morals committee.
Seeing her free-spirited and extravagant mother as a good example of what not to do, Ritsuko grew up to be strict and stern.
Proud of her Fujishima heritage and aware of it's importance, she feels disdain towards the unworthy main character.
